scope: 070002 official 2019-2025 H1/FY report acquisition and content qualification; no returns

initial_parser_failures.resolution: Allow whitespace between title terms and confirm the cover sent date against the official announcement date.

initial_parser_failures.resolution: Anchor the section by 股票代 and separately require complete rank sequence and holdings sum equal the disclosed stock-asset amount.

initial_parser_failures.cause: The first page locator could point at a table-of-contents mention or another occurrence of a balance amount.
initial_parser_failures.resolution: Bind page numbers to the exact body-text match offset; read-back confirmed every reported heading, first holding row, share-flow, balance-sheet and transaction page.

final_outcome: 14 of 14 reports qualified after the above corrections; no missing report remains.
